title: Ship Init Repo, reload restoration and selected-task live output
objective: Complete the AIWorkHub VS Code editor-tab repository UX. Replace the GLM-specific primary action with one prominent Init Repo action that atomically provisions every required repo-local AIWorkHub authority for a new repository. Repair reload deserialization so an already open tab rebuilds its repository-bound MCP client without close/reopen. Add a read-only bounded Live Output view for the selected task. Model invocation diagnostics, if retained, must be provider-neutral, explicit and secondary. Reuse existing canonical storage and ProcessManager authorities; create no fallback database or second log store.
acceptance: Only when canonical storage readiness reports the explicit not_initialized state does the dashboard show Init Repo as the primary action; other failures show their real diagnostic and never masquerade as initialization.
Initialization never runs automatically on activation, reload, refresh, workspace switch, model discovery or task polling; it requires an explicit owner click and confirmation.
Init Repo canonicalizes the workspace root with platform APIs and works on Windows drive/junction paths, Linux/macOS symlinks, WSL and Remote-SSH without hard-coded host paths.

One explicit initialization atomically provisions repository identity/manifest, storage registry, canonical task database, Source Graph state, Session Manager, AI Memory, KB, callback/run/log locations and generated agent tool-use instructions under that repository's .aiworkhub authority.
Initialization is idempotent and non-destructive: existing valid state is reused, incompatible foreign repo identity fails closed, and partial failure never reports storage ready.
After successful initialization the same tab reconnects and transitions to Live without reload; Init Repo disappears completely and the dashboard only reads the existing repository-local authorities.
An initialized repository never auto-imports legacy databases, adopts another repository's state, creates fallback storage, or repeats bootstrap work during ordinary dashboard use.

The extension consumes only the versioned aiworkhub.claude_callback.v1 sideband envelope produced by B856, capability-detects the installed Claude Code extension, and reports panel binding honestly; no private API guessing, keystroke injection or clipboard injection is allowed.
The extension registers a WebviewPanelSerializer for the canonical AIWorkHub editor view type and fully rehydrates an open dashboard tab after window reload or extension-host restart.
Deserialization reapplies webview options/HTML/message handlers, recreates the repository-bound MCP client, resumes refresh, and transitions Connecting to Live without close/reopen.
Webview getState/setState or extension workspaceState restores only bounded presentation state such as selected task, filters and refresh interval; no task data or secrets are duplicated there.
Repeated deserialize/open cycles leave exactly one live panel controller and dispose old timers, listeners and MCP children.
The primary dashboard contains no GLM-specific canary block or hard-coded GLM invocation action; successful Model Capabilities discovery is presented as discovery only.

Any retained invocation smoke is provider-neutral, located under explicit diagnostics, requires model selection plus native credit confirmation, and never runs on refresh, reload, timer or task pickup.
Selected Task contains a Live Output section with combined or separately labeled stdout/stderr tail, liveness/exit state and last activity.
Only the selected task is queried; no dashboard-wide log fanout occurs.
The MCP response is bounded to at most 64 KiB, supports incremental cursor/offset refresh, and reports truncation.
ANSI/control sequences are removed, HTML is escaped, and configured secret redaction is applied before data reaches the webview.
Output is read only from the selected repository's .aiworkhub runtime records and cannot cross repository identity.
Claude/DeepSeek/GLM CLI launches captured by AIWorkHub are supported; opaque Copilot or Claude Chat sessions show output_unavailable with adapter reason.
Terminal tasks retain their final bounded tail; missing/deleted logs fail closed without degrading the whole dashboard.
Focused Python, Node serializer lifecycle and VSIX packaging tests pass.
